about: Data scout ledger (Nick 11:35 PM Nov 4 2026, EXP-097). Candidates found by the scout, license-checked and ranked by new information per GB. Pulled data is counted in docs/data-ledger.json (the Data Division crews A-F, docs/plans/2026-11-05-data-division.md); this file is the pipeline in front of it. Render with: python scripts/scout_ledger.py Scout experiment ids: EXP-1600-1699. Owner = the crew that pulls it (A pbp, B context, D markets); 'scout' = still being probed. Video principle (Nick 12:15 AM): extract features on the fly (numbers, timestamps), never store raw video. Rank order (Nick 2:00 AM Nov 5): NBA impact first, then NFL, then shared basketball/football pretraining, then other sports (shared pretraining only).
token_rule: tokens = events x 6 for event streams (noggin_tokens vocab v1). Three kinds, counted separately (Nick 11:50 PM): 'events' = new real plays/pitches/balls; 'context-new' = external facts we did not have (odds, weather, refs, injuries, TV slot), counted ONCE per game as unique tokens, with as-fed tokens (repeated on every play by vocab v2) shown only in the why line; 'derived' = computed from data we already hold (WP, leverage, momentum, timeouts left, lineups, player-to-date, standings and playoff odds, rest and travel): adds tokens per play but no new knowledge. Synthetic and augmentation (mirror, re-timing) are never in this file; they are capped at 3x real in data-ledger.md.
info_per_gb_rule: score = new_tokens_m x novelty / raw_gb. novelty 1.5 = adds wall-clock timing we lack; 1.0 = new sport, league or level; 0.5 = more of a league we already hold.

verdicts.green: free to use, credit at most
verdicts.yellow: usable with a stated condition (credit, non-commercial, Nick accepts a rules tab)
verdicts.yellow-B: restrictive terms; usable only under data plan B for personal use; tag personal-use
verdicts.red: not using (bot-block, login, paywall, or terms we cannot meet even under B)
